objective: Milestone 5: Candidate Discovery, Host Pacing and Language Scoring

tasks.description: Implement RSS 2.0 and Atom XML source feed adapter for official admissions and scholarship feed collection, extracting item title, canonical link URL, publication date, GUID/id, and sanitized summary text within bounded payload limits.
acceptance_criteria: parseRssOrAtomFeed(xmlText) parses standard RSS 2.0 and Atom XML feed payloads into structured feed items
Extracts title, link URL, publication date (RFC 822 / ISO 8601), and unique identifier (guid or id)
Safely strips/sanitizes HTML from summary/description and normalizes relative links against optional feed root URL
Enforces maximum payload size and maximum item count limits to prevent memory exhaustion
Handles invalid XML, namespaces, CDATA, and missing fields gracefully with safe fallbacks
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/rss-feed.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement coordinated host-wide collection rate limiter and pacing service to track per-host request intervals, enforce minimum delays derived from host robots crawl-delay or default minimum cadence, and prevent concurrent request bursts against the same university domain.
acceptance_criteria: createHostPacer(options) tracks per-host timestamps and schedules or evaluates next eligible request time
Enforces host-level minimum intervals respecting parsed crawlDelaySeconds and minimum floor
Binds host keys by normalized origin hostname (lowercased, default ports removed)
Provides concurrency limiting per host to prevent parallel fetches against a single origin
Operates in-memory with deterministic clock injection in unit tests
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/host-pacer.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement deterministic language proficiency score evaluation and qualification matching service for applicant profiles against scholarship requirement criteria, supporting IELTS (0–9), TOEFL iBT (0–120), and Chinese HSK (Levels 1–6) score comparisons.
acceptance_criteria: evaluateLanguageRequirement(profileScores, requirement) deterministically checks applicant eligibility against opportunity language criteria
Supports IELTS band scores (including overall and sub-band minimums), TOEFL iBT total scores, and HSK level + total score rules
Evaluates test score validity window / freshness relative to opportunity deadline
Returns structured match result with boolean eligible, deficit details, and human-readable explanation keys
Handles missing or exempt applicant test scores with safe fallback semantics
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/language-scoring.test.ts && npm run typecheck
